chapter.verse: Tu-in mi siangthote' tunga seppina vai note' kiangah kong gelh pen a valthau khat hi lel hi.
A hang pen Macedonia mite' kiangah Achaia mite nikuma kipan a kigingsa-in om khin ci-in note' thu ka kisialh mah bangin kinna lungsim na neih uh kong thei hi.
Himah taleh ka na gensa bangin note a kigingsa na hih ding uh deihna tawh hih vai ah note' thu ka kisialh teng a hawmpi a suah loh nadingin sanggamte hong sawl ka hi hi.
Tua hilo-in Macedonia mite kei tawh hong kithuah uh henla note a kigingsa hilo cih hong mu uh hileh, no cih thadah, ko zong hih banga ka lungmuan uh ka zumhuai ding uh hi.

Tua hangin na kamciamsa uh citpiakte, sawlzawh thu tawh ahilo, deihsakna citpiak bangin a baihsa ahih nadingin note' kiangah sanggamte hong paikhol hong vankhol dingin ka na hanthot ding kisam ka sa hi.
Deihna bulpi ah: tawmnono a vawh peuhmah in tawmnono bek at ding a, tampipi a vawh peuhmah in tampipi mah at pah ding hi.
Lungdamna tawh a piate Pasian in pakta ahih manin mi kim in iksik pipi leh sawlzawh thu tawh hilo-in lungsim sunga a khensat bangin a piak ding ahi hi.
Note a tawntungin na khempeuh a kicingin nei-in nahoih sepna ah a gina a thahat na hih nadingun Pasian in hehpihna a namkim tawh note hong kidimsak thei hi.
Hih bangin zong kigelh hi: “Amah in cinghtak hawmkhia-in mizawngte' tungah piakhia a, ama' dikna a tawntungin kip hi.”
Khaici vawhpa' tungah khaici pia-in annek dingin anlum a piapa in note' vawh dingin khaici hong sikin hong pungsak ding a, note' dikna hong gahphasak ding hi.
A namkimin na cit zawh nadingun a namkimin hong hausak ding a, tua in kote' tungtawnin Pasian' tungah lungdamkohna piangsak ding hi.
A hang pen hih panpih nasepna in mi siangthote' kitangsapna a dip bek hilo-in Pasian' tungah lungdamkohna tampi dimletsak hi.

Amaute in Khris' Lungdamna Thu na sanna uh pana hong piang nomau' niamlutna hang ahi zongin, amaute leh midangte khempeuh' ading citna tawh na hopkhiatna uh hang ahi zongin, hih nasepna pana a kilangkhia thute tungtawnin Pasian' minpha phat ding uh hi.
Tua kawmin amaute in note' tunga tehtheihloh Pasian' hehpihna hangin note hong mu nuamin thu hong ngetsak uh hi.
A manphatna a kigen zolo deihguat thupha hong pia Pasian tungah i lungdam hi.
